versions.changelog: Clarify integration with @linzi007/zhizhi-math-worksheet: same-agent handoff of selected questions, scope and language preferences; return PDFs, source mappings and review status before resuming authorized records or sync. Document companion installation in the same scope. No automatic dependency installation or new background permissions.

Add complete-paper photo archives, a durable background photo queue, evidence-based concept assessment, and model-designed worksheets. Integrate the standalone worksheet skill; add English output-language rules and model-HTML answer labels. Fix scoped Git commits, selected-only publishing, and deployment tracking. Validated with 25 regression tests. Archive initialization and some legacy labels remain China-specific; English PDF visual testing and learner-outcome validation remain outstanding.
Optimize daily grading workflow with compact active context, diagnosis validation, run logging, subagent boundary, and deferred grading push.
Support configurable local IANA timezone for OpenClaw scheduled reminder jobs.
Add OpenClaw scheduled reminder setup with automation config and cron registration fallback commands.
Add machine-readable learning workspace config plus automatic pull/commit/push and Pages publishing guidance for configured personal learning repositories.
Clarify the ClawHub summary with the project origin and English-only metadata.
Improve ClawHub-facing summary metadata with English-first copy and Chinese helper text.
Add a project origin note explaining that the skill was created to help Zhizhi, a first-grade child, with math tutoring and to support parents with similar needs.
Add PDF-first worksheet delivery plus explicit GitHub cloud sync and Pages setup guidance with parent-friendly instructions.
Improve OpenClaw onboarding docs with quick reference, first-use checklist, and clearer Skill-to-Plugin roadmap.
Auto-publish generated worksheet pages, rebuild the public index with all worksheets and status columns, wait for GitHub Actions deployment, and document direct-push ruleset settings.
Add public-repository GitHub Pages guidance, branch-safety notes, and a helper for creating the GitHub Actions Pages workflow.
Prefer repository Deploy key setup for GitHub sync, add public-key generation helper, and document first-reply and publish-time authorization guidance.
Add GitHub sync authorization guidance, fine-grained token permission recommendations, and plain-git preflight checks.

Document recommended model capabilities and rationale: use a vision-capable frontier reasoning model for worksheet photos, handwriting uncertainty, long-context learning records, structured worksheet specs, geometry, and complex word problems.

Add personal learning workspace initializer; clarify ClawHub user setup, workspace/data boundaries, and GitHub sync guidance; keep installed skill bundles out of personal learning repositories by default.
